name: A second traveler in Aquarius
blurb: One degree north of the first field, also on the ecliptic. Here SPHEREx caught a dot crossing the patch over about a day and a half in June 2025.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2025-06-02, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.40 um. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
